bio.text: Derek Tran represents California's 45th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and is serving his first term.
He was born and raised in Los Angeles County, served eight years in the U.S. Army Reserve, and received a B.S. from Bentley University and a J.D. from Glendale University College of Law.
He worked as an attorney, was a traffic commissioner for the City of Orange, and co-owns an independent pharmacy with his wife.
